## Uninstall

If you used the setup, uninstall VRCFaceTracking from Settings, Apps, Installed apps. The app, its Start menu entry and its SteamVR registration are removed, and then the uninstaller offers to delete your settings, installed modules and logs as well. Say No if you also use the Steam version. It reads the same settings and modules.

If you extracted it by hand, close VRCFaceTracking and delete the folder. Settings and modules are in `%AppData%\VRCFaceTracking` and logs in `%LocalAppData%\VRCFaceTracking\logs`. Delete those two folders too to remove everything.
